components.name: Back to terminal
components.description: Plain return control in the sticky project top bar.
components.html: <button class="ds-back"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 10H4m5-5-5 5 5 5"/></svg>Back to terminal<kbd>Esc</kbd></button>
components.css: .ds-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;color:var(--cover-ink,#f4f0e4);font:12px/1.5 var(--mono-font, 'Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace);cursor:pointer}.ds-back svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6}.ds-back kbd{margin-left:5px;padding:1px 5px;border:1px solid #7c9378;border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:2px;font:10px/1.5 var(--mono-font, 'Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace);color:#d1dfc8}.ds-back:hover{color:var(--cover-ink,#f4f0e4)}.ds-back:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d5e9a5;outline-offset:5px}.ds-back:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Document link

components.css: .ds-report{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:17px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #8ca383;color:#164b2d;font:500 18px/1.5 var(--body-font, Plex, Arial, sans-serif);text-decoration:none}.ds-report span{font:22px/1 var(--body-font, Plex, Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-report:hover{color:#0a2c16;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-report:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #315e34;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Project navigation
components.description: Quiet previous/next navigation with title emphasis.
components.css: .ds-navigation{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;padding:42px 0 56px;background:var(--cover,#0c1915)}.ds-navigation button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;color:var(--cover-ink,#f4f0e4);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-navigation button:last-child{align-items:flex-end;text-align:right}.ds-navigation span{font:12px/1.5 var(--mono-font, 'Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace);color:var(--accent,#d5e9a5)}.ds-navigation strong{font:500 clamp(24px,2.3vw,32px)/1.2 var(--body-font, Plex, Arial, sans-serif);letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-navigation button:hover strong{color:#d5e9a5;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}.ds-navigation button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d5e9a5;outline-offset:5px}.ds-navigation button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.css: .ds-window{width:min(620px,calc(100vw - 32px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 36px);padding:7px;border:1px solid #6a7567;border-radius:9px;background:#343c34;color:#e9ecda;box-shadow:0 28px 70px #0009;overflow:auto}.ds-window-rail{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:54px;padding:6px 7px 6px 18px;background:#b5bca8;color:#202d22;border:1px solid #d0d5c1;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;font:12px/1.5 var(--mono-font,"Plex Mono",Consolas,monospace)}.ds-window-rail button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-width:94px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #52634e;border-radius:3px;background:#2c3b2d;color:#f1edda;font:12px/1.5 var(--mono-font,"Plex Mono",Consolas,monospace);cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease}.ds-window-rail svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7}.ds-window-rail button:hover{background:#1b2c20;color:#fff8e5}.ds-window-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #263e28;outline-offset:3px}.ds-window-rail button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-window-body{padding:32px 30px 30px;background:#0d1812;border:1px solid #4c5a49;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 3px 3px}.ds-window-body h2{margin:0 0 28px;color:#eee7c9;font:500 42px/1.12 var(--body-font,Plex,Arial,sans-serif);letter-spacing:-.035em}.ds-window-body p{margin:0;max-width:52ch;font:16px/1.85 var(--body-font,Plex,Arial,sans-serif)}@media(max-width:560px){.ds-window{width:calc(100vw - 24px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px);padding:5px;border-radius:7px}.ds-window-rail{gap:10px;padding:5px 6px 5px 12px;font-size:10px}.ds-window-rail button{min-width:82px;gap:8px;font-size:11px}.ds-window-body{padding:26px 20px 22px}.ds-window-body h2{font-size:35px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-window-rail button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A physical vintage computer establishes the identity. The charcoal studio, phosphor display, pixel wordmark, and tactile keyboard make navigation feel like using a small personal machine. Project pages extend that character with a dark split cover pairing the title and live artwork, then a full-width warm-paper reading chapter with carefully set type and spacious source figures.

About, Contact, and Credits appear as compact application windows with a graphite hardware frame, pale title rail, dark inset pane, and an amber email action. Plain paper sheets and generic green panels are rejected for these dialogs.

The hierarchy stays direct: the terminal leads the main page; the work leads each project page. Motion illustrates the subject and connects the CRT to the opened page. Copy remains concise and factual, with source captions and credits where they are needed.
keyCharacteristics: Physical computer and pixel CRT identity.
Dark live-art covers and warm paper with dark green ink for sustained reading.
Locally hosted Plex typography with distinct reading and control roles.
Continuing project animation and restrained interface chrome.
Hardware-framed dialogs with a pale rail and amber primary action.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep long project reading on paper; keep pixel navigation inside the terminal display.

rules.name: The Type Role Rule
rules.body: Use Plex Sans for reading, Plex Mono for controls and facts, and pixel lettering for the CRT identity.

dos: Do preserve the physical terminal and pixel CRT identity.
Do keep reading hierarchy in Plex Sans and controls in Plex Mono.
Do preserve source captions, credits, and truthful project status.
Do continue the selected animation into the project hero and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't add decorative slogans, repeated labels, or filler sections.
Don't invent project results or present illustrative scenes as experiment recordings.
Don't replace the preserved ML decision-field animation.
Don't add metric cards or floating shadows to the paper reading pages.
